context:
Supporter: Good afternoon, how can I help you today?
Seeker: Hi there, I am just stressed about giving a presentation tomorrow
Supporter: That is understandable, public speaking is one of the most commonly cited fears for people. Is it for work or for school?
Seeker: This presentation is for school I am indeed worried about public speaking
Supporter: I actually majored in communication and have a great deal of experience with public speaking.
Seeker: That's interesting, I find public speaking to be especially difficult
Supporter: Yes, the physical nervousness that can manifest is powerful. I would highly recommend finding a quiet place to calm and focus your mind for at least five minutes before your presentation. At least a minute's worth of breathing, and drink plenty of water.
Seeker: That very helpful advice, I think another stressful factor is being able to field questions effectively
Supporter: Ah, yes, that is a hard one. You are expected to be an expert. But you can only prepare so much.
Seeker: Agreed, and there is always that fear that you won't know an answer
Supporter: "That is a really great question that I've never considered! Maybe XYZ? I can check on that and get back to you with a sure answer though!" There's no shame in being able to say that you understand why someone would ask the question(whatever it may be) but that you don't have a full or even partial answer right now. Because you're also going to get like, the hecklers and the people who want to look intelligent by asking asinine questions
Seeker: I can understand that, as a I try to prepare for the presentation it's stressing me out about all of the different types of potential questions. But the advice you gave is very good
original_response: Just feel confident that you have fulfilled the assignment according to the guidelines. Extra questions from students are wildcards and you can only handle them within the scope of the assignment. If someone's like WELL WHY AREN'T THERE PURPLE PANDAS THEN, JEFF?! you're gonna have to just laugh lol
control_response: Focus on whether you’ve completed the assignment according to the guidelines. Questions from other students are unpredictable, and you can only address them within the assignment’s scope. If someone asks something irrelevant like, “Well, why aren’t there purple pandas then, Jeff?” you can simply laugh it off.
ev_response: It makes sense that trying to anticipate every possible question feels stressful. Trust that you’ve completed the assignment according to the guidelines. Questions from other students can be unpredictable, and you can only address them within the assignment’s scope. If someone asks something totally out of left field, like, “Well, why aren’t there purple pandas then, Jeff?!” sometimes you just have to laugh it off.
